blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) on Friday welcomed more than $5 billion worth of approved US arms sales to the Philippines. During a bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Malacañang, US President Donald Trump said he had supported increased foreign military financing and approved $5 billion worth of arms sales to the Philippines since taking office. The AFP said the US support would contribute to the country’s military modernization program and efforts to strengthen its defense capabilities. “We appreciate the continued support of the United States in strengthening the AFP’s capabilities,” AFP spokesperson Col.
